text: Coffee with Caroline. Her son Ibrahim starts reception on 3rd of September and she's already teary about it. Her husband works nights at the hospital so she's doing drop off alone. Text her that morning to see how it went.
Haruto lives in Leeds now, works for an architecture firm near the station. His sister Akira is in Osaka still, teaching English. Wife's called Ruby, they met at uni.

Nasser's daughter graduates from Edinburgh on June 3rd. He's flying up with his mum the day before. Proud as anything, wouldn't stop showing me photos. His son Karan is in sixth form and already talking about doing the same course, which Nasser pretends to hate. His wife can't go, she's got a work conference in Dubai that week.

Long catch up with Naledi. She's moved to Bristol, renting a flat above a bakery which she says is dangerous. Still at the council, planning department. Her brother Chidi just got engaged to a girl called Afua, wedding probably next summer. Her mum's hip op is 14/05 and Naledi's going home for a fortnight to help. Should send her mum flowers.
Arturo said his twins sit their GCSEs from 12 May. Marisol is fine, Damian is a wreck about maths. Need to message Damian good luck before the first paper.
Ana and Aneesh are hosting a joint graduation party for their eldest on Saturday 21st. I'm doing the cake. Their youngest is nine and obsessed with dinosaurs, worth knowing for presents.
Ryan's off to Canada for work, 6/14 to 6/28. Partner Siddharth staying behind with the dog, a greyhound called Biscuit. Ryan's nervous about the presentation in Toronto.
Bumped into Nadia at the school gates. Her little one Chioma lost her first tooth yesterday and the tooth fairy apparently paid a fiver. Inflation.
Farah's working from home three days a week now, at an insurance company in Croydon. Lives in Sutton with her partner Anil and his mum. Anil's vegetarian, Farah isn't.
Call with Dong. Her son Dawit got into Manchester for medicine! Results came through Thursday. She's planning a little dinner on the 30th. Must send a card and something for Dawit.
Antoine's brother died in March, I hadn't known. He seemed okay but tired. Should check in with him in a couple of weeks.

Grace is struggling, her mum's been in and out of hospital since August. Grace's kids are 7 and 10, husband Joseph travels a lot for work. She's barely sleeping. Her brother Damian lives in Spain and isn't much help apparently. Mum's next scan is 2nd of November. Ring her on Sunday, and maybe offer to take the kids one afternoon.
Pick up dry cleaning Thursday, renew passport before the end of November.
Damian Evans, Dami to everyone, starts his apprenticeship with an electrician on Monday 2nd. His dad Marcus is relieved, school was never his thing.
Yara and Salma are celebrating their tenth anniversary on 9 October with a trip to Lisbon. Salma hinted she'd love a decent coffee grinder. Karan says he's chipping in for a gift.
Karan's daughter has her Grade 5 piano exam next Tuesday, April 22nd. She practises every night apparently. Karan reckons she's going to cry before it.
Ebony works at the vet's on the high street, been there six years. Lives with her nan in the flat by the park. Allergic to nuts, severely.

Ruby says her parents are moving down from Glasgow on the 1st of December to be nearer the grandkids. Her dad Uncle Marcus as the kids call him has Parkinson's, so the move's a big deal. I'm helping with boxes that weekend.

Catch up with Ibrahim. Graduation was 18 July, finally done with the PhD. Job at Novak Pharma starts in September. His mum flew in from Cairo and cried the whole ceremony. Wants to celebrate properly once he's settled. Text him congrats, I never did.
Haruto mentioned his son's first day at nursery went well, only cried for five minutes. Ask Haruto how the second week is going.
Chidi's mum's 70th is on 14 May. Big party at their church hall the Saturday after. Chidi wants everyone to bring a photo of her for a board. Don't forget to dig one out.
Arturo Barros lives in Lisbon half the year, the rest in Brighton. Retired from banking. Collects old fountain pens. Wife Marisol paints.
Afua's driving test got moved from 3/12 to 3/26. Fourth attempt. She's really anxious this time, says she'll give up if she fails. Wish her luck the night before.
Naledi's baby is due early February! Feeling sick constantly though, can barely eat. Her partner Dawit is over the moon. She's keeping work quiet for now.

Spoke to Nasser about his brother Anil, who's been made redundant after twenty years. Anil's got a meeting with HR on the 7th about the package. Nasser's worried he'll sink. I should invite Anil for a pint after. Anil's wife Farah works at the library part time, so money will be tight, and their eldest starts uni in September. Nasser's helping with the CV.
Siddharth's dad's surgery is Friday. Bypass. Sid's taking the week off to be at the hospital. Text Sid Thursday night and then again Saturday.
Chioma and Antoine's wedding was supposed to be 5 June, now called off. They've split, she's moved back to her mum's in Peckham. Check in with Chioma next week.
Ana's boy Marcus is doing his A levels from mid May, then hoping for Leeds. Ana's convinced he isn't revising. Her husband works at the airport, shifts all over the place.
Dong Yilmaz is the new head of science at the girls' school. Lives in Harrow with her husband and two cats, Pepper and Salt. Hates coriander.
Grace said Joseph's graduation from the nursing course is on the 12th of July. He's the first in his family to go to uni. She's organising a surprise lunch afterwards. Get him a card and a nice pen.

Caroline's daughter Ebony is starting secondary in September, terrified of the bus. Caroline's thinking of driving her the first week. Ryan's kids go to the same school, might ask Ryan if his eldest can look out for her. Caroline's mum lives with them now too, moved in after the stroke last spring, so mornings are chaos.
Ryan and his wife are off to Kenya for her cousin's wedding, 8/2 to 8/16. They're leaving the kids with his parents. He's excited, never been.
Aneesh got the promotion! Senior manager from the 1st. His wife Nadia is planning drinks at the Fox on Friday 10th. Grab a bottle of something for him.
Yara's dog Rolo had an operation on his leg last week. Recovering but miserable in the cone. Yara's taking time off to look after him.
Damian's partner Salma lives in Cardiff during the week for work, they do weekends. He's in Bristol still. Thinking about getting a place in Newport to split the difference.
Farah's son sits his eleven plus on 13 September. She's hired a tutor twice a week. He doesn't seem bothered, she's more stressed than him. Ask her after how he got on.

Dinner at Antoine's. His mum's visiting from Lyon until the 3rd of November. His sister Yara is pregnant again, due around Easter. Antoine's thinking about leaving his job at the bank to retrain as a teacher, though he hasn't decided. Lovely evening, his mum made tarte tatin.
Akira lives in Kyoto with her husband Haruto Suzuki and their daughter. Works in translation, mostly manuals. Her daughter's eight and learning violin.
Marisol's hen do is the weekend of April 18th, wedding May 2nd. I'm going to both. She wants no gifts, just a donation to the hospice.
Note to self: book dentist, sort car insurance by the 28th.
Dawit starts at the new firm on 4/7. Leaving the old place on the 31st with drinks after work. He's a bit sad to leave Karan, they've worked together eight years. Should go to the drinks.

Chat with Salma. Her son Karan graduated from Leeds on Tuesday with a first. She's thrilled. Her other boy Anil starts uni in Glasgow next month and she's dreading the empty nest. Her husband Joseph just retired from the post office. Message Karan congrats and maybe ask Salma for a coffee once Anil's gone.
Marcus Jensen, the new neighbour at 14, is a paramedic. His partner Grace teaches PE. They have a little boy and a very loud spaniel.
Ebony's brother Ryan passed his driving test this morning, first go! She's chuffed for him. Their mum was the one teaching him, apparently nerves of steel.

Joseph and Ruby are moving to Norwich, exchanging contracts the 20th, completion end of November. Kids are switching schools in January. Ruby's anxious about it. Need to call her after completion. Joseph's new job at the hospital starts 12/1, which is why they're going. Their eldest, Ruby junior aka RJ, is gutted about leaving her friends.
Naledi said her niece has her first ballet show on 15 March and she's flying back to Durban for it. Her sister Afua made the costume.

Caught up with Siddharth over lunch. He's now at a startup in Shoreditch doing payments stuff. Lives with his brother Aneesh in Walthamstow. Their mum is coming over from Pune on 2nd of December for a month. Sid's gluten free these days.
Nadia's mum passed on Sunday. Funeral's on 27 October in Birmingham. Nadia's holding up, mostly. Remind me to send a card and maybe drop off food Thursday.
Ibrahim's little girl started school this week. Ibrahim said she marched in without looking back and he was the one who cried. Mrs Ahmed is her teacher, same as Ibrahim's nephew had.
Haruto wants to run the Berlin marathon on September 27th. Training already, 40 miles a week. His wife Caroline thinks he's mad.
Antoine's kids: Grace is 12, Joseph 9. Grace wants to be a vet. Joseph loves Lego, especially the Star Wars sets, good shout for his birthday.
Text from Afua. Her dad's knee replacement went fine yesterday, home on the 9th. She's staying with him till the 15th. Drop her a message on the weekend to see how he's doing.
Chidi said his son's first school exams start 5/18. He's in year 10. Chidi works from home so he's on revision duty. His wife is a dentist in Croydon.
Grandparents' anniversary dinner is the 3rd. I'm booking the restaurant, need to confirm numbers by Friday.

Dawit's sister Farah is getting married in Addis on December 12th. Dawit's going out for a fortnight with his mum. He's best man and nervous about the speech. Ask him how the speech went when he's back.

Ana mentioned Salma's going through a rough patch. Split from her partner, moving out on the 1st. Their daughter is staying with Salma mostly. Ana said Salma'd appreciate a call. I should ring her this week. Ana herself is fine, busy with her daughter's university applications, deadline 15 January. Her husband Chidi is still at the council.
Ruby Olsen is the new receptionist at the surgery. Grew up in Bergen, moved here for her husband's job. He's an engineer. They've got a cat called Mango.
Karan's mum is turning 60 on 22 November. He's planning a surprise party at their house on the Saturday before. She's been dropping hints about a spa day. Chip in with Karan for that.
Aneesh's daughter got her degree results: 2:1 in history. Graduation's on 20th July. He's driving up to York with his parents for it. He said the parents are prouder than she is.

Quick call with Marisol. Her son Arturo's football tournament is May 9th and 10th in Sheffield. He made the county squad! Her ex Damian's taking him. Marisol's at her sister's in Spain that week so she'll miss it, gutted. Text Arturo good luck on the Friday.
